name: Goa
description: A vibrant blend of coastal beauty, colonial architecture, beach shacks, water sports, and tranquil inland spice plantations.

attractions.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus & Old Goa
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage Baroque church holding the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier.
attractions.indoor_alternative: Archaeological Museum & Old Goa Art Gallery

attractions.name: Palolem Beach & Silent Bay
attractions.description: Crescent beach with calm waters, dolphin cruises, and colorful wooden shacks.
attractions.indoor_alternative: Goa Chitra Museum & Indoor Spice Workshop

attractions.name: Sahakari Spice Farm Tour & Lunch
attractions.description: Guided walking tour through cardamom, vanilla, and peri-peri plantations with authentic Goan buffet.

attractions.name: Fort Aguada & Lighthouse Viewpoint
attractions.description: 17th-century Portuguese fortress overlooking the Mandovi River meeting the Arabian Sea.

attractions.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Walking Tour
attractions.description: Historic Latin neighborhood with bright terracotta roofed Portuguese heritage homes and artisan bakeries.
attractions.indoor_alternative: Gitanjali Art Gallery & Confeitaria 31 de Janeiro

halal_options: Halal Chicken Xacuti at Fisherman's Wharf

precautions: Keep sunscreen and stay hydrated; coastal humidity can cause rapid fatigue.
Check beach flags before entering the sea; red flags indicate high currents.
Rent certified scooters/cars only with valid helmets and insurance.
etiquette: Dress respectfully when visiting churches and temples (cover shoulders and knees).
Avoid clicking pictures of sunbathers without consent.
Say 'Deu borem korum' (May God bless you in Konkani) to warm up to locals.

name: Jaipur
tagline: The Majestic Pink City & Royal Palaces
description: Rajasthan's capital is a royal spectacle of hilltop fortresses, intricate handloom bazaars, and astronomical marvels.

attractions.name: Amber Fort & Palace Grandeur
attractions.description: Iconic hilltop fort with Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace) and elephant/jeep transit.

attractions.name: City Palace & Royal Observatory (Jantar Mantar)
attractions.description: Living royal palace showcasing textiles, weaponry, and world's largest stone sundial.

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal Facade & Wind Palace Photo Walk
attractions.description: 953 jharokhas (small windows) honeycomb facade built for royal ladies to witness street life.

attractions.name: Nahargarh Fort Sunset Viewpoint
attractions.description: Panoramic sunset over the entire Pink City from the Aravali hills.

attractions.name: Johari & Bapu Bazaar Craft Walk
attractions.description: Traditional pink-columned bazaars famous for lac bangles, blue pottery, and bandhani sarees.

veg_options: Dal Baati Churma with Pure Ghee
jain_options: Authentic Jain Dal Baati with Boondi Churma
halal_options: Halal Mutton Curry at Handi Restaurant

precautions: Carry water and sun hats during palace courtyard walks.
Negotiate politely with auto-rickshaws or use e-rickshaws / Uber.
Check museum closing times on national holidays.
packing_list: Light woolen shawl or jacket for evenings
Comfortable walking shoes (marble floors can be slippery)
etiquette: Remove footwear outside temples and sanctums.
Bargaining is expected in old bazaars, but do so with a smile.

name: Munnar
tagline: Emerald Hills, Cloud Peaks & Tea Estates
description: A tranquil hill station nestled in Kerala's Western Ghats, blanketed by rolling tea gardens, misty waterfalls, and rare flora.

attractions.name: KDHP Tea Museum & Factory Experience
attractions.description: Fascinating journey of CTC tea processing with tea-tasting sessions.
attractions.indoor_alternative: KDHP Tea Tasting & Film Screening Hall

attractions.name: Eravikulam National Park (Nilgiri Tahr Sanctuary)
attractions.description: Home to the endangered mountain goat and the blooming Neelakurinji flowers.

attractions.name: Mattupetty Dam & Eco Point Boating
attractions.description: Speedboating, natural echo phenomenon, and misty hill views.

attractions.name: Punarjani Traditional Kathakali & Kalaripayattu Village
attractions.description: Spectacular live classical Kathakali dance and martial arts demonstration.

veg_options: Kerala Sadya served on banana leaf
jain_options: Jain Coconut Stew with Steamed Appam
halal_options: Halal Chicken Biryani at Rapsy Restaurant

precautions: Mountain roads are winding; keep motion sickness pills if sensitive.
Carry a light fleece or warm layer as evening temperatures drop quickly.
Leach protection socks recommended if walking into deep wet tea gardens.
etiquette: Respect tea pickers at work and avoid plucking leaves without permission.
Keep the hills clean; strict zero-plastic waste rules are enforced.

name: Manali
tagline: Himalayan Snow Peaks, Pine Forests & Solang Valley
description: High-altitude haven in Himachal Pradesh offering snow sports, apple orchards, ancient cedar temples, and thrilling mountain passes.

attractions.name: Hadimba Devi Cedar Temple
attractions.description: 16th-century four-tiered pagoda wooden temple surrounded by gigantic deodar trees.
attractions.indoor_alternative: Museum of Himachal Culture & Folk Art

attractions.name: Solang Valley Snow & Adventure Arena
attractions.description: Paragliding, zorbing, ATV quad biking, and winter skiing with cable car rides.
attractions.indoor_alternative: Solang Ropeway Glass Restaurant & Indoor Games Lounge

attractions.name: Atal Tunnel & Sissu Waterfall Gateway
attractions.description: World's longest highway tunnel above 10,000 feet leading to dramatic Lahaul landscapes.

attractions.name: Old Manali Cafe Street & Manu Temple
attractions.description: Bohemian wooden cafes, live acoustic music, handmade woolen shops, and stone alleyways.

non_veg_options: Trout Fish with Lemon Butter Sauce
jain_options: Jain Veg Thukpa (Rice noodles in clear broth)
halal_options: Halal Chicken Momos & Biryani at Mall Road

precautions: Acclimatize slowly; avoid excessive cardio on Day 1 if feeling altitude shortness.
Check Atal tunnel & Rohtang pass snow advisories before heading out early.
Rent certified snow suits and boots directly at official government stands.
packing_list: Heavy thermal innerwear & windproof down jacket
Woolen gloves, beanie and thermal socks
etiquette: Spin prayer wheels only in clockwise direction at monasteries.
Keep noise levels low in silent pine forest trails.

name: Hampi
description: UNESCO World Heritage open-air museum filled with monolithic granite temples, royal baths, and stunning sunsets over the Tungabhadra river.

attractions.name: Vijaya Vittala Temple & Stone Chariot
attractions.description: 56 musical pillars that produce resonant tones and the legendary stone chariot on the 50 rupee note.

attractions.name: Virupaksha Temple & Sacred Bazaar
attractions.description: Oldest continuously operating 7th-century sanctuary with temple elephant Lakshmi.

attractions.name: Coracle Ride on Tungabhadra River & Sanapur Lake
attractions.description: Circular wicker-boat drift beneath colossal boulder canyons.
attractions.indoor_alternative: Indoor Boulder Climbing Wall & Hippie Cafe

attractions.name: Matanga Hill Sunrise Panorama
attractions.description: 360-degree viewpoint looking out over endless rocky monoliths and green paddy fields.

veg_options: Jolada Rotti Oota (Sorghum flatbread with brinjal curry)
non_veg_options: Fish Thali (served across the river in Anegundi)
jain_options: Jain Jolada Rotti with Lentil Gravy
halal_options: Halal Chicken Fried Rice at Mango Tree

precautions: Midday sun can be scorching; plan outdoor ruins exploration for early morning and late afternoon.
Wear sports shoes with firm tread for climbing boulder staircases.
Carry sufficient cash as some temple ticket counters face network drops.
packing_list: Wide-brimmed sun hat & UV protection sunglasses
Refillable water flask with electrolyte powder
etiquette: Refrain from climbing directly on sculpted stone reliefs and pillar motifs.
Footwear must be deposited outside functioning sanctums.

name: Varanasi
tagline: The Spiritual Capital of India & Sacred Ghats
description: One of the world's oldest continually inhabited cities, sacred to millions, vibrant with riverside aartis, ancient silk weavers, and labyrinthine alleys.

attractions.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat Evening Ganga Aarti
attractions.description: Grand synchronized ritual with multi-tiered brass oil lamps, conch shells, and devotional chants.

attractions.name: Kashi Vishwanath Corridor & Golden Temple
attractions.description: Revered Jyotirlinga shrine renovated with spacious stone corridor stretching to the river.
attractions.indoor_alternative: Kashi Vishwanath Temple Museum & Audioguide Centre

attractions.name: Dawn Rowing Boat Cruise (Assi to Manikarnika Ghat)
attractions.description: Watch the morning sun rise over the mystical eastern riverbanks as sadhus perform sun salutations.
attractions.indoor_alternative: Subah-e-Banaras Classical Music Pavilion at Assi Ghat

attractions.name: Sarnath Buddhist Deer Park & Dhamek Stupa
attractions.description: Where Lord Buddha gave his first sermon; features the original Ashoka Lion Capital museum.

non_veg_options: Available outside the sacred old quarter (Cantt area mutton curries)
jain_options: Pure Jain Kachori without onion/garlic at Kashi outlets
Jain Thali at Sri Krishna Bhawan
halal_options: Mughlai Kebabs and Nihari in Madanpura

precautions: Keep wallets secure inside crowded narrow lanes (galis).
Book government-approved boatmen to ensure standardized rates.
Wear easy slip-on shoes for temple visits.
etiquette: Strictly no photography allowed at cremation ghats (Manikarnika and Harishchandra).
Respect priests and pilgrims performing morning ablutions.

emergency_info.hospital: Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Sir Sunderlal Hospital (+91 542 230 7500)

name: Coorg (Kodagu)
tagline: The Scotland of India, Coffee Estates & Waterfalls
description: Mist-shrouded hills in Karnataka with lush arabica coffee plantations, cardamom groves, wildlife sanctuaries, and rich Kodava martial culture.

attractions.name: Coffee & Spice Plantation Walking Trail
attractions.description: Guided tasting of single-origin robusta/arabica beans and fresh black pepper harvesting.

attractions.name: Abbey Falls & Hanging Bridge
attractions.description: Roaring waterfall cascading through lush private coffee estates.

attractions.name: Namdroling Golden Temple (Bylakuppe Tibetan Settlement)
attractions.description: Magnificent 40-foot gilded Buddha statues and reverberating Tibetan prayer chants.

attractions.name: Raja's Seat Sunset Garden & Musical Fountain
attractions.description: Historic viewpoint where Kodagu royalty watched sunset over rolling green valleys.

veg_options: Akki Rotti (Rice flatbread) with Bamboo Shoot Curry (Kani Curry)
Kadambuttu (Steamed rice balls) with Veg Gravy
non_veg_options: Pandi Curry (Iconic Coorg Pork with Kachampuli vinegar)
jain_options: Jain Akki Rotti with Coconut Chutney
halal_options: Halal Coorg Chicken Biryani at Hotel Capitol

precautions: Carry umbrellas during monsoon/post-monsoon as passing showers are frequent.
Check estate opening times before driving down private estate mud paths.
etiquette: Respect estate boundaries and avoid trampling seedlings.
Maintain quiet decorum in Tibetan monasteries.

name: Andaman Islands
tagline: Turquoise Lagoons, Coral Reefs & Tropical Paradise
description: Archipelago in the Bay of Bengal boasting crystal-clear azure waters, Radhanagar white sand beaches, active coral reefs, and historical Cellular Jail.

attractions.name: Radhanagar Beach (Havelock Island) - Asia's Best Beach
attractions.description: Pristine turquoise water framed by lush tropical rainforest, famous for breath-taking sunsets.

attractions.name: Cellular Jail National Memorial & Light Show
attractions.description: Historic colonial prison housing freedom fighters with poignant evening light and sound narration.
attractions.indoor_alternative: Cellular Jail Historical Gallery & Photo Archive

attractions.name: Elephant Beach Snorkeling & Sea Walk
attractions.description: Vibrant shallow coral reef exploration, sea walking with underwater helmet, and glass-bottom boats.
attractions.indoor_alternative: Samudrika Naval Marine Museum Port Blair

attractions.name: Ross Island (Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Island)
attractions.description: Historic ruins wrapped by banyan tree roots, friendly spotted deers, and peacocks.

veg_options: South Indian Rice Meals with fresh coconut chutney
Paneer Tikka with tropical lime soda
non_veg_options: Fresh Grilled Red Snapper with Garlic Butter
jain_options: Pure Jain South Indian Dosas & Meals at Annapurna
halal_options: Halal Seafood Platter at New Lighthouse Restaurant

precautions: Strict prohibition on collecting corals or seashells (heavy fines at airport security).
Pre-book inter-island high-speed ferries (Makruzz / Nautika) to avoid delays.
Wear life jackets at all times during watercraft excursions.
packing_list: Waterproof dry bag for boat journeys
Extra memory card for underwater photography
etiquette: Never touch living coral structures or disturb marine creatures.
Do not attempt to contact or photograph indigenous tribal protected zones.
